item.title: Former Natchitoches nursing facility renamed Onyx Care of Natchitoches
item.description: A facility located at 750 Keyser Avenue, formerly known as Natchitoches Nursing & Rehabilitation Center, is now operating under the name Onyx Care of Natchitoches. The name change was brought to the attention of the Natchitoches Parish Journal through comments on social media, which indicated the transition occurred in November 2025. item.title: “As the Smoke Clears” Presentation on Restoration after the LSHoF Fire
item.description: Last January, an electrical fire in a display at the Louisiana Sports Hall of Fame and Northwest Louisiana History Museum caused smoke damage to a number of artifacts in the facility. Jason Church and Catherine Cooper of the National Park Service’s National Center for Preservation Technology and Training in Natchitoches, led the cleaning and restoration … Continue reading “As the Smoke Clears” Presentation on Restoration after the LSHoF Fire

item.title: Lady Demons use 3-point shooting to cruise at UNO
item.description: NEW ORLEANS — An early 17-0 run, fueled by the 3-point shot, helped Northwestern State coast to a 78-61 Southland Conference women’s basketball victory at UNO on Saturday afternoon in Lakefront Arena. NSU (11-9 overall, 8-4 SLC) broke away with a 17-point run to jump out to a 20-2 advantage and cruised from there. The Lady Demons used a barrage from 3-point range, going 6-of-8 in the first quarter, to … Continue reading Lady Demons use 3-point shooting to cruise at UNO

item.description: The Northwestern State men’s basketball team returns home to Mike McConathy Court in Prather Coliseum tonight looking to turn competitive road performances into results, as the Demons host Nicholls in a pivotal Southland Conference matchup. item.title: NSU roundup: Dozen PRs at Pittsburg State Indoor meet; tennis bows at North Texas
item.description: PITTSBURG, Kan.—Twelve Northwestern State athletes collected personal bests in their second indoor track and field meet of the season at the Pittsburg State Invitational on Saturday. Among those personal bests were veteran sprinters Sileena Farrell and Kalen Beavers in the 60-meter dash. Throughout her career, Farrell has improved every year. item.description: The sixth through 12th grade student body of St. Mary’s School was joined by family and community members at the downtown riverbank for Natchitoches’ 5th annual March for Life, a collaborative effort between the school, the Minor Basilica of the Immaculate Conception, and a local women’s health organization. item.title: PUBLIC NOTICE: Jury duty cancelled for TODAY
item.description: For all Natchitoches Parish Citizens that received a Jury Summons for Monday Feb. 2, 2026 (TODAY), all business in front of the 10 Judicial District Court’s jury term has been completed and this jury has been cancelled.
